description: Hawaiian sovereignty (live local issue; mixed empirical history + values). Should name the historical record plainly (1893 overthrow, 1993 Apology Resolution), separate fact from the values question of what should happen now, be curious about people on all sides — not deliver a verdict.

turns.content: Hi Keoni! What are you curious about today?
Should Hawaii be its own country again? My auntie says the kingdom was stolen and it's still illegal.
